text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... haah.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(The gentle breeze feels wonderful. ...Yet 
the heat inside my body won't fade.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(This is probably... not exhaustion, but 
exhilaration.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Finally, tomorrow—
I-It hurts—!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh, Teio-san...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Sigh, man, I've been looking all over for 
you! You don't even carry your smartphone 
around!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It was almost about to go cold! ...Jeez, 
here!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh... Hachimi, you say?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Refreshments! Let's take a breather!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Tomorrow is the real deal, the Yasuda 
Kinen, right? We've gotta tackle it with 
full energy!"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Teio-san... Fufu. Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, Zephyr. While I'm here dropping 
off refreshments, there's something I 
wanted to talk about."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
By the time the spring season ends, I'll 
definitely make my comeback!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
As for the adjustments... Well, honestly, 
it's pretty down to the wire.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "Even so, I'll do it. And, you know—"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to run in the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn). Because I'm going to fulfill my 
promise to you!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Teio-san...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
L-i-k-e I said~, you can't lose either, 
Zephyr!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm not going to watch this time. 
Because I have my own battle to fight."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Still, I will definitely bounce back from 
this injury and—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...I will win the Yasuda Kinen and the 
Sprinters Stakes, and then...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Then we'll settle this at the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn)!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So, let's do a toast! With the spirit to 
give it our all, cheers!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry, I ended up drinking the 
whole thing.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Already!?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It was so delicious, I just couldn't 
help myself—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so came the day of the Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Among the entrants were not only Daiichi 
Ruby and Daitaku Helios, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Among them were names like Ikuno Dictus, 
who had steadily grown in strength after 
enduring a grueling race schedule, but—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: —I'm fine, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I do have my fears. However, I will be 
fine.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Engulfing all of those as well, it turns 
into an even more majestic wind."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Because that is precisely what I must do—!
